summary: Backend-only verification of the new iOS Safari Google redirect-mode auth path + daily inactive-cleanup scheduler. Extended /app/backend/tests/test_n2m_backend.py with TestGoogleRedirectMode (3 tests), TestGoogleIdTokenPopup (2 tests), TestAdminGate (1 test); updated TestRoot to assert auth=='google-direct'. ALL 18 in-scope tests PASS (1.4s). Verified: (1) POST /api/auth/google-redirect with form-encoded {credential='obviously-not-a-real-jwt', g_csrf_token='abc123'} returns HTTP 303 with Location header containing 'auth_error=invalid_credential' — graceful, no 500. (2) Same call with ?ref=alice query param also returns 303 with auth_error=invalid_credential — ref accepted, short-circuits before referral logic. (3) POST /api/auth/google-redirect with missing 'credential' form field returns 422 (FastAPI validation, not 500). (4) POST /api/auth/google with {credential:'not-a-real-jwt'} returns HTTP 401 with JSON body containing 'detail' field mentioning 'credential' — popup regression path is graceful. (5) POST /api/auth/google with empty JSON returns 422. (6) GET /api/auth/me without session/bearer → 401. (7) GET /api/ → {app:'Nice2Meechu', auth:'google-direct'} confirming GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID is configured and direct GIS mode is active. (8) POST /api/admin/inactive-cleanup?days=90&dry_run=true with no auth → 401. (9) GET /api/feed without auth → 401 (and 8 other protected endpoints in TestAuthGuard, all returning 401). Backend scheduler verification: cleared backend log, ran two full `sudo supervisorctl restart backend` cycles. Each cycle shows 'Application shutdown complete' followed by 'Application startup complete' with ZERO tracebacks. _inactive_cleanup_loop is created on startup via @app.on_event('startup') and cancelled cleanly on shutdown — no CancelledError leak, no warnings.
action_items: PRE-EXISTING (out-of-scope for this review): /app/backend/tests/test_n2m_backend.py `auth` fixture's onboarding POST still uses the OLD payload {handle, vibes, language, avatar_emoji}; the OnboardingReq schema now requires first_name/city/age (server.py lines 100-108). This causes 10 setup ERRORS in TestAuth/TestProfile/TestFeedSwipeMatch/TestOgCard/TestReferral. Tests for the *new* features (this review) do not depend on the `auth` fixture so they all pass. Main agent should refresh the auth fixture payload to: {first_name:'Test', city:'New York', age:25, vibes:[], language:'en', avatar_emoji:'🌙'} OR change handle to be a separate post-onboarding step if the API still supports it.
PRE-EXISTING (out-of-scope): TestSamples.test_samples_list fails with KeyError 'samples' — /api/samples response shape changed. Update test to match new response keys.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py:_inactive_cleanup_loop is a single asyncio.Task; if it raises *during* await asyncio.sleep on shutdown the outer cancel() will propagate CancelledError into the loop body — currently the bare `except Exception` does NOT catch CancelledError (good in 3.8+ since it's BaseException), so cancellation propagates correctly. No issue, but consider catching CancelledError explicitly in the outer scope and exiting silently for ultra-clean shutdown logs.

server.py:auth_google_redirect (line 327) hardcodes redirect URL as `/?auth_error=invalid_credential` (relative path). This works because the frontend is served from the same origin as the backend (via ingress /api prefix routing), but if the backend is ever fronted by a different domain the redirect will land on the wrong host. Acceptable for now — flagged because the comment on line 299 says 'DO NOT HARDCODE THE URL' and a relative redirect technically inherits the request host.
server.py:_inactive_cleanup_loop initial sleep is 900s by default — useful in prod, but means a fresh container won't sweep for 15min on cold start. Acceptable; documented in comment.

Background task ref `_INACTIVE_CLEANUP_TASK` is module-global; if uvicorn worker is restarted by --reload it leaves the old task orphaned on the dying event loop. The shutdown hook handles cancel, but if shutdown is skipped (SIGKILL) the task just dies with the loop — harmless but should rely on supervisord's graceful term signal.

server.py:auth_google_id_token (popup, line 364) includes the raw exception text (`f'Invalid Google credential: {exc}'`) in the 401 detail. Comment says this helps debug iOS Safari issues, but it does leak google-auth library internals to the client. Acceptable for now (it's a verification failure, not PII) — flag for security review pre-launch.
updated_files: /app/backend/tests/test_n2m_backend.py (updated TestRoot.test_root_metadata to expect auth='google-direct'; added TestGoogleRedirectMode with 3 tests for the new /api/auth/google-redirect endpoint covering invalid credential 303 redirect, ref query-param acceptance, and missing-credential 422; added TestGoogleIdTokenPopup with 2 regression tests for POST /api/auth/google; added TestAdminGate verifying /api/admin/inactive-cleanup requires auth)
test_credentials: No real Google JWTs available — only negative-path verification per review scope. Existing seed-via-Mongo pattern documented in /app/memory/test_credentials.md still applies for any positive-path tests.
seed_data_creation: None — all new tests are stateless negative-path probes that hit unauthenticated endpoints.
context_for_next_testing_agent: iOS Safari redirect-mode auth (POST /api/auth/google-redirect) is verified for the negative path: invalid JWT → 303 to '/?auth_error=invalid_credential'. The endpoint accepts form-encoded body (Form(...), NOT JSON) plus optional ?ref=<handle> query string. Use requests.post(..., data={...}, allow_redirects=False) — NOT json=. The 303 status is INTENTIONAL success-shape for the unauth probe. Daily _inactive_cleanup_loop runs every INACTIVE_CLEANUP_INTERVAL_SECONDS (default 24h) after INACTIVE_CLEANUP_INITIAL_DELAY_SECONDS (default 900s). It's wired via @app.on_event('startup')/(shutdown') and cancels cleanly. Pre-existing test fixture issue in the auth fixture (OnboardingReq schema drift) needs main-agent fix before TestProfile/TestFeed/TestReferral can be re-run, but is unrelated to this review.
rca of the issue: No new bugs introduced by this change. One historical traceback in backend.err.log ('TypeError: a coroutine was expected, got <Future pending>' at server.py:187 inside current_user → asyncio.create_task) was traced to an OLD code state; the current source (line 190-199) correctly wraps the Motor update inside an async helper `_touch_seen` before create_task. Clean log after fresh restart confirms the fix is in effect.
